prompts.baita:
Use case: identity-preserve. Image 1 is the exact RIGHT-facing neutral combat sprite. Create a HURT animation key-pose sheet, same face identity, hair, costume, props, proportions and camera. Head/nose/body still face SCREEN RIGHT, no gaze at viewer. Exactly FOUR equally sized cells, TWO columns by TWO rows, 1536x1024 landscape, transparent background with alpha=0 in all empty areas. Each 768x512 cell shows one complete full-body character with all equipment, same scale and ground baseline 90% cell height, 8% padding each side. Reading order: TOP LEFT neutral same pose as reference; TOP RIGHT recoil hit reaction, lean upper body backward toward LEFT while knees soften and face remains RIGHT, pained brief squint; BOTTOM LEFT brace/recover halfway upright, eyes back at right opponent; BOTTOM RIGHT original neutral same as reference. Hurt is a SHORT sharp recoil, not an attack or giant flinch. Keep both feet/floor baseline and camera fixed, no per-pose resizing. All props intact, no scene, no letters/numbers/labels/cell dividers, no fog/backdrop glow, no halo, no floor shadow. Crisp antialiased boundaries, clean simplified hard-edge anime painting. First and fourth poses stay nearly identical; ONLY second and third are the hit reaction changes.
Character constraints: Keep her sitting on the SAME chair facing right: chair legs and chair back absolutely fixed, book still on lap, two small floating books intact. Recoil upper torso and head backwards left, one hand reflexively protects chest while other steadies lap book; brace recovers toward seat. Do not tip the chair or make her stand. Preserve green eyes/brown curls/white blouse/green suspender dress.
